reason: Last year we did the party at home and it was cramped, so this year I want it somewhere else, and Dziupla is close with a 4.9 rating. I'd ask in 'Mamy z Banina' first, but if a weekend slot is free I'd probably book FUN, because the whole class comes and a 7-8 year old won't just sit at a table.
objection: Will there be a free weekend slot at all? Also, is a play room for kids aged 1-8 too babyish for my 7-8 year old and classmates? And not being able to bring our own cake for the adults irritates me, since it pushes the price up.
would_change_my_mind: If no Saturday or Sunday slot near the birthday date is free, or the mums in the group say older kids get bored there, I'd look elsewhere.
